name: Sakura Tanaka
psychographics: Optimizes for flow state; sees convenience apps as essential infrastructure, like electricity or train lines
current_solutions: Rakuten Girls Talk for grocery delivery, subscription to a premium laundromat service that picks up and folds, Omakase meal kits for weekends, Apple Pay for all transit and purchases
frustration: Had to manually input a promo code at 11:58pm on a Sunday to get free delivery on a grocery order; the app crashed right before the confirmation screen, forcing her to re-enter card details and lose the discount
decision_style: Taps the fastest checkout button; if the UI is smooth, she trusts the brand instantly
voice: Rambling and rapid, switching between English and Japanese technical terms. Uses lots of emojis and filler words like 'like' and 'so'.
